name: feature-input-validation
prompt: `createUser` in `validate_user.js` currently accepts any input without validation. Add validation, checked in this order - name, then email, then age - so it throws a plain `Error` with exactly one of these messages: "name is required" if `data.name` is missing or an empty/whitespace-only string; "email is invalid" if `data.email` is missing or does not contain an "@"; "age must be a non-negative integer" if `data.age` is missing, not an integer, or negative. When every field is valid, it should still return `{ name, email, age }` exactly as before.
